battle.name: 窩闊台攻宋之戰
battle.brief: 一二三五年秋，窩闊台汗在六盤山議定攻宋，兵分三路：主力南下破汴京、趨襄漢，拖雷取大散關入蜀，別軍略湖南江西。一二三六年成都、潭州陷落，德安守將高達苦守歲餘，城破殉節；孟珙收復襄樊、鄂州。一二四一年窩闊台病逝，蒙古軍北撤。卡面希臘火是拜占庭銅管燃燒劑，未嘗現身宋境。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是蒙古帝國（漢人史籍稱蒙古）與南宋。蒙古一方以窩闊台汗為最高統帥，一二三五年秋在陝西六盤山召開庫里台，決定全面攻宋，兵分三路：其一由窩闊台自將主力，經河套、山西南下，出河套後沿黃河南岸與汴水流域東進，攻取河南、荊襄；其二由睿宗拖雷率領，自陝西鳳翔出大散關，假道宋境入蜀，攻成都、嘉定、瀘州、渝州；其三為經湖北南下、攻略湖南江西的別部。蒙古軍沿用草原千戶制，百戶、千戶逐級統屬，騎兵每兵備數匹馬，攻城所需的工匠與器械多由金與西夏降附的漢人及回回工匠操辦，老營隨大軍遷徙，輜重車隊與畜群跟著戰線移動。南宋一方由理宗趙昀主持，中樞設樞密院與三衙，地方分路安撫司與經制司，荊湖兩路以孟珙為統帥，江淮、川陝各置守臣。蒙古在河南與襄漢得手之後，只留少量兵丁鎮守州縣，大軍仍集結在鄉野與營壘之間，因此南宋只要組織一次反擊就能收回失地。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Mongol Empire, called the Mongols in Chinese sources, and the Southern Song. On the Mongol side the supreme commander was the khagan Ogedei, who convened a kurultai at the Liupan Mountains in Shaanxi in the autumn of 1235 and decided on a full invasion of Song, dividing his forces into three columns. The first, led by Ogedei himself, came down from the Hetao and Shanxi, then moved along the south bank of the Yellow River and the Bian River corridor to seize Henan and the Jing-Xiang region. The second, under the Wise Regent Tolui, left Fengxiang in Shaanxi, passed through the Dasan Pass into Sichuan by permission of Song, and struck Chengdu, Jiading, Luzhou and Yuzhou. The third was a separate force that moved south through Hubei to ravage Hunan and Jiangxi. The Mongol army kept the steppe decimal organisation, hundreds and thousands of men answering to the next rank up, each horseman keeping several remounts; the craftsmen and the siege engines were mostly handled by Han Chinese and Huihui artisans surrendered by Jin and Western Xia, while the old camp with its baggage trains and herds moved along with the army. The Southern Song was governed by the emperor Lizong Zhao Yun, with the Privy Council and the Three Commands at the centre, provincial pacification offices and military administration commissions in the regions, Meng Gong as commander of the two Jinghu circuits, and separate commanders in Jiang-Huai and Sichuan-Shaanxi. Once the Mongols had taken Henan and Jing-Xiang they left only small garrisons in the prefectures and kept the bulk of the army massed in the countryside and in their camps, so that a single well-organised Song counterstroke could win the ground back.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩方。蒙古方面，窩闊台汗是攻宋的決策者，他在六盤山定策後分派兵馬，這場遠征的成敗大半繫於他的健康；一二四一年他在歸途中病逝，諸王奉其子貴由即位，遠征軍隊隨即北撤。睿宗拖雷是入川一路的主帥，他自大散關入蜀，於一二三六年攻下成都、嘉定與瀘州，隨後沿江東下直抵鄂州一帶；他在攻宋途中病逝（一二三七年），部眾由其子拔都與諸將率回北返。汪德臣是前線的重要統將，長期指揮四川與荊襄方向的小股奔襲，據《元史》本傳，他於一二三九年攻重慶時中創而卒。劉伯林等漢人將領亦隨睿宗入蜀，參與成都、嘉定的攻城。南宋方面，孟珙最為關鍵，他主持荊湖防務，在襄漢、德安、鄂州三役中屢次出擊、夜襲蒙古營壘、焚毀攻城器械，又主持修築鄂州城與沿江寨壘，是六年間唯一能以攻代守扭轉局面的統帥。德安守將高達以孤城拒守蒙古軍歲餘，援兵不至，城破之日自殉，屍身寄於富池口；潭州守將李芾與城共存亡，其後朝廷追諡。四川方面則由趙立、趙葵先後收拾殘局，一二四〇年趙葵入蜀，蒙古軍北撤之後宋軍收復成都。
peopleEn: Key figures fall on both sides. For the Mongols, the khagan Ogedei was the man who decided on the invasion; after the Liupan deliberation he allotted the armies to the three columns, and the success of the whole expedition hung largely on his health, for he fell ill and died on the road home in 1241. The princes then enthroned his son Guyuk, and the expeditionary armies began to withdraw. The Wise Regent Tolui commanded the column into Sichuan: he entered through the Dasan Pass, took Chengdu, Jiading and Luzhou in 1236, and then marched down the river as far as the Ezhou region; he died of illness during the campaign in 1237, and his men were led back north by his son Batu and the other generals. Wang Decheng was an important field commander who for years led raids by small bodies of troops in Sichuan and the Jing-Xiang sector; the History of Yuan records that he was wounded and died in 1239 while attacking Chongqing. Han Chinese commanders such as Liu Bolin also accompanied the Wise Regent into Sichuan and took part in the sieges of Chengdu and Jiading. On the Song side the central figure was Meng Gong, who directed the defence of Jinghu. In the three actions at Xiangyang, De'an and Ezhou he repeatedly sortied, raided the Mongol camps by night and burned their siege engines, and he supervised the rebuilding of Ezhou's walls and the river forts; he was the only commander of those six years able to reverse the situation by offence rather than by defence. Gao Da, the governor of De'an, held an isolated city against the Mongols for more than a year; with no relief coming, he killed himself on the day the city fell, and his body was laid in a coffin at Fuchi mouth. Li Fei, governor of Tanzhou, went down with the city, and the court later granted him a posthumous title. In Sichuan the wreckage was gathered up by Zhao Li and then Zhao Kui; in 1240 Zhao Kui entered the province, and after the Mongols withdrew the Song recovered Chengdu.
kits: 本卡的希臘火是拜占庭的銅管發射燃燒劑，七世紀中葉定型，最早見於敘利亞沿海的海戰，其後在八世紀君士坦丁堡的圍城中被大量使用；配方由宮廷技師掌握，銅管內所裝是以石油為基的混合物，點燃之後極難撲滅。蒙古軍在西征中於西亞與東歐接觸到這條技術線，其後在攻西夏與攻宋的戰役中使用的是同族技術的猛火油，即以石腦油為基的稠液，盛在皮囊與陶罐中，綁上撞車或投石機的彈體送向城頭，遇火即成一片，也有以火把點燃油囊順風投擲的用法。南宋一方同樣備有猛火油，主要用來燒毀蒙古的攻城塔與雲梯，以及在江漢水戰中焚燒敵舟。必須說明的是：拜占庭式的銅管噴射器在宋境戰場並無記載，希臘火並未以卡面這種形態出現於窩闊台攻宋之役，此卡屬技術譜系的一端，戰場上真正存在的是它的後裔，即盛在皮囊陶罐裡的猛火油。同場的裝備還包括蒙古的複合反曲弓、長標槍、札甲與鎖子甲、馬甲與馬鐙，攻城所用的雲梯、攻城塔、撞車與石砲，渡河用的革囊與木筏，以及被徵發到攻城前線的漢地匠人；宋軍方面有神臂弓、霹靂砲與火藥箭，漢水與長江上的鐵索橫江，以及壕溝、甕城與陷馬坑。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on this card is the Byzantine burning liquid fired from a copper tube, a device settled in the middle of the seventh century and first recorded in a naval battle off the Syrian coast, later used in quantity during the eighth-century siege of Constantinople; the formula was a secret of the imperial technicians, and the mixture packed into the copper tube was based on petroleum and burned in a way that was extremely hard to extinguish. The Mongols encountered this line of technology in the West during their campaigns, and what they used against Western Xia and against Song was the close relative of the same family, the wild fire oil made from naphtha: a thick liquid carried in skin bags and earthen jars, lashed to the bolts of battering rams or traction trebuchets and driven at the walls, where a single spark turned the whole front into a sheet of flame; there was also the practice of lighting the bags with a torch and hurling them downwind onto the parapet. The Southern Song kept the same material, mainly to burn the Mongols' siege towers and ladders and to set enemy boats alight in the river fighting of the Han and the Yangtze. It has to be said plainly: the Byzantine copper siphon appears in no record of any battlefield in Song territory, and Greek fire in the form shown on this card did not take part in Ogedei's war against Song. The card stands at one end of a technical lineage, and what actually stood on the battlefield was its descendant, the wild fire oil carried in bags and jars. Sharing the field were the Mongols' composite recurved bows, long spears, lamellar and mail armour, horse harness and stirrups, and for the siege their ladders, siege towers, battering rams and stone trebuchets, together with inflated skin bags and timber rafts for crossing rivers and the Han craftsmen conscripted to the siege lines. The Song had crossbows with the heavy draw of the Shenfu bow, thunder crash bombs and fire arrows, chains laid across the Han and the Yangtze to stop the Mongol boats, and ditches, barbicans and horse pits around their walls.
tactics: 蒙古的戰術核心是速度與分割。遠征部隊以騎兵為主，每兵備數匹馬，靠輪換維持行程，抵達宋境後先以哨騎與遊騎掃清外圍據點，迫使宋軍分兵應戰。攻城時蒙古人先送招降書，限十日作答，屆期不從即列攻城器械：雲梯、攻城塔與撞車同時進逼，城外挖環城溝壘以斷援軍與糧道，再以石砲與火砲覆蓋城頭，掩護架梯攀城之兵登城。守方最有效的反制並非死守，而是以奇兵夜襲營壘、燒毀攻城器械；孟珙在襄漢與鄂州一線屢用此法，使蒙古的攻城器屢建屢毀。蒙古在攻宋初期多避開宋軍設防的重心，轉而長驅掠取州縣、斷絕糧源，令宋廷疲於奔命；但每次深入必留後援與老營，遠離牧地之後馬匹因缺草料與潮濕而掉膘，進攻節奏被迫放慢，南方江河的雨季也讓輜重與攻城器的運轉時時受阻。防守一方以守為攻：荊湖沿漢水與長江築寨設防，江面以鐵索橫江阻擋蒙古舟師，川陝則在江流險要處依山築城。
tacticsEn: The core of Mongol method was speed and division. The expedition was mounted throughout, each horseman keeping several remounts so that the column could keep up its pace; on reaching Song territory the scouts and outriders first cleared the outlying posts and forced the Song to spread its troops in answer. When they came to a city the Mongols first sent a summons allowing ten days for an answer, and if none came they brought up the engines: ladders, siege towers and battering rams advanced together, a ring ditch and rampart were dug outside the walls to cut off relief and supply, and stone and fire trebuchets covered the parapet while the ladder parties went up. The best counter from the defenders was not passive resistance but a night sortie to burn the engines; Meng Gong used that method repeatedly along the Xiangyang and Ezhou line, and the Mongols built and lost their siege equipment again and again. Early in the campaign the Mongols avoided the points where the Song had concentrated, preferring long sweeps through the prefectures to cut the grain routes and wear the court out, but every deep push left a rearguard and the old camp behind, and once the armies moved away from the pastures the horses lost condition for want of fodder and damp, the pace of advance slowed, and the rainy season of the southern rivers kept jamming the baggage and the engines. The defence was fought as a form of offensive: along the Han and the Yangtze the Jinghu circuit built forts and stockades, chains were laid across the water to hold back the Mongol flotilla, and in Sichuan-Shaanxi cities were built against the rocks of the gorges.
data: 可考的數字有限，且多出自宋人奏議與元代起居注一類的轉述。蒙古出兵的規模，兩代史籍說法不一，多稱十餘萬至數十萬，未見統一可靠的記載，其部署為三路大軍，每路再分若干萬戶所部，騎兵每兵備數匹馬。宋金聯兵滅金之後，雙方於一二三四年議定和約，其中一項是宋每年向蒙古納銀二十萬兩、絹二十萬匹，並另付犒軍銀。攻城時間可考者：潭州自受攻至城破歷時數月；德安自受圍至城破約一年，一二三六年十一月被圍，一二三七年春城破。蒙古軍入川之後在成都一帶屯駐四年，一二四〇年宋軍收復成都。孟珙一方在六年間先後收復襄陽、樊城、德安、隨州與鄂州，並重修鄂州城垣。整場戰爭自一二三五年秋開戰至一二四一年冬蒙古軍北撤，歷時約六年。行程方面，主力自河套與雲中南下至汴京以千里計，再南至長江中游的襄陽、鄂州，總程亦逾兩千里。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, and most come from Song memorial literature and Yuan court records rather than from a single authority. The size of the Mongol force is given differently in the two literatures, most often as somewhere between a hundred thousand and several hundred thousand men, and no reliable single count survives; the deployment was three great columns, each divided again into units of ten thousand households, and each horseman carried several remounts. After the Song and the Mongols joined to destroy Jin, the two sides made a settlement in 1234, one term of which was that the Song should pay the Mongols every year two hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk, together with a separate indemnity for the troops. The length of some sieges can be checked: Tanzhou stood for several months between the first assault and the breach; De'an was invested for about a year, surrounded in the eleventh month of 1236 and lost in the spring of 1237. After entering Sichuan the Mongols garrisoned the Chengdu region for four years, and in 1240 the Song recovered the city. Over those six years Meng Gong's side retook Xiangyang, Fancheng, De'an, Suizhou and Ezhou in turn and rebuilt the walls of Ezhou. The whole war ran from the autumn of 1235 to the withdrawal of the Mongols in the winter of 1241, about six years. As for distance: the march of the main column from the Hetao and Yinzhou down to Bianjing ran to the thousand li and more, and the further march south to Xiangyang and Ezhou on the middle Yangtze added a comparable distance, the whole road exceeding two thousand li.
cause: 三路大軍並非為一城一池而起。金哀宗自縊於蔡州，金朝在北方僅存的屏障於一二三四年初消失，蒙古與南宋之間的緩衝地帶從此不存在，這是攻宋最直接的背景。端平入洛之後，宋廷趁金亡收復河南三京，蒙古視之為違約，隨後以宋未如約輸出歲幣、沿邊將吏不交還等為口實重新集兵。深層的理由在草原經濟的壓力：蒙古的戰爭機器依賴牧場與畜群，長期駐紮中原會耗盡牧地與馬匹，而南宋的江南提供了它急需的穀物、絹帛與工匠，攻下淮河至長江之間的州縣，等於取得一座現成的倉庫。窩闊台的諸王在六盤山議事時並不一致，主張先經營北方與西域者不少，最終仍以全面攻宋定案。
causeEn: Three great columns were not raised for the sake of a single town. When the Jin emperor Ai committed suicide at Caizhou, the last screen the Jin dynasty still held in the north vanished in the early months of 1234, and the buffer between the Mongols and the Southern Song ceased to exist; that is the most immediate background to the invasion. After the Duanying recovery of the Three Capitals of Henan, the Song court took advantage of Jin's fall to win them back, and the Mongols treated that as a breach; they then gathered troops again on the pretext that the Song had not paid the annual tribute as agreed and had not handed back the border officials. The deeper reason lay in the pressure of the steppe economy: the Mongol war machine depended on pastures and herds, and a long garrison in the Chinese plain exhausted the grazing and the horses, while the Jiangnan of the Southern Song offered the grain, the silk and the craftsmen that the empire badly needed; to take the prefectures between the Huai and the Yangtze was to seize a warehouse already built. Ogedei's princes were not of one mind at the Liupan deliberation, and there were many who argued for consolidating the north and the western regions first, but the decision for the full invasion of Song was taken.
impact: 六年戰爭把南宋的國防線往南推了一個身位：河南大部與襄漢數州一度易主，成都、嘉定、瀘州亦曾淪陷數年。州縣城池往往只留少量兵丁鎮守，主力仍隨大軍移動，因此南宋只要組織一次反擊就能收復失地，這一特徵在孟珙收復襄樊、鄂州與宋軍重入成都的過程中反覆出現。技術面上，蒙古軍第一次在長江中游大規模用水陸配合攻城，雖然沒有碰上釣魚城那樣的絕地，卻把攻城器的製造、壕壘圍困與封鎖江面結合起來，這套經驗在十餘年後蒙哥攻宋時被放大使用。希臘火一線的技術譜系也在此役之後走進中原，猛火油自西域與西亞傳入的同時，宋軍也以火藥與火油反制，焚燒攻城塔、阻斷水師，雙方都以火作為攻城與反攻城的核心手段。民生與經濟的破壞同樣深遠：河南、荊湖、江西、四川多地田園荒廢，北方南來的流民一批批移入江浙，州縣的戶籍與賦役名冊在戰後需要重新丈量；遠在草原的蒙古貴族也第一次體會到南方濕熱氣候與水網對騎兵大軍的束縛。
impactEn: Six years of war pushed the Song's frontier back by one stage: much of Henan and several prefectures of Jing-Xiang changed hands, and Chengdu, Jiading and Luzhou were occupied for years at a time. The prefectural cities were often left with only small garrisons while the bulk of the army moved on, so that a single Song counterstroke could win them back; that pattern repeated itself in Meng Gong's recovery of Xiangyang and Ezhou and in the Song army's return to Chengdu. On the technical side this was the first time the Mongols fought a large-scale combined land and river operation on the middle Yangtze, and although they never faced a position like Diaoyucheng, they did combine the manufacture of siege engines, siege by ditch and rampart, and the sealing of the river, and that experience was scaled up when Mongke attacked the Song a dozen years later. The Greek fire line of technology also entered the Chinese interior after this campaign: wild fire oil arrived from the western regions and from western Asia, and at the same time the Song answered with gunpowder and fire oil of its own, burning siege towers and breaking up the enemy's flotilla, so that fire became a core instrument of siege and counter-siege on both sides. The damage to life and livelihood was just as deep: farmland lay abandoned in Henan, Jinghu, Jiangxi and Sichuan, refugees from the north moved south into Jiangnan in wave after wave, and the household registers and tax rolls of the prefectures had to be surveyed afresh after the war; the Mongol aristocracy far away on the steppe learned for the first time how the damp heat of the south and its mesh of rivers could hold down a great cavalry army.
result: 蒙古第一次大規模攻宋以虎頭蛇尾收場。一二三六年起成都與潭州相繼淪陷，一二三六年冬至一二三七年春，德安與襄樊在苦守與反擊中先後易手，蒙古一度深入江西腹地，卻在鄂州、江陵一線被孟珙以寨壘、夜襲與鐵索橫江擋住，攻勢就此停滯。一二四一年秋蒙古軍主力仍在河南、荊襄一帶，窩闊台汗在歸途中病逝，諸王奉貴由即位，軍隊奉命北撤，攻宋之役就此中止。撤退之後，南宋先後收復襄陽、樊城、德安、隨州與鄂州，成都亦重歸朝廷之手，兩國在淮河至大別山一線形成新的對峙，約有十二年沒有大規模交鋒。從技術上看，這一役證明宋軍在江防與山城體系下足以抵禦騎兵優勢，也暴露了宋廷恃守不反與蒙古遠征無法在南方維持補給的雙重局限，直到蒙哥再啟大舉，雙方才又回到戰場上。
resultEn: The first great Mongol invasion of Song ended in an anticlimax. From 1236 Chengdu and Tanzhou fell in turn; between the winter of 1236 and the spring of 1237 De'an and Xiangyang changed hands after bitter defence and counterstroke; the Mongols drove deep into the interior of Jiangxi, but at the Ezhou and Jiangling line they were halted by Meng Gong's forts, night raids and chains laid across the river, and the offensive stopped there. In the autumn of 1241 the main Mongol force was still in Henan and Jing-Xiang when the khagan Ogedei fell ill and died on the road home; the princes enthroned Guyuk, the army was ordered north, and the campaign against Song was halted. After the withdrawal the Song retook Xiangyang, Fancheng, De'an, Suizhou and Ezhou, and Chengdu returned to the court's hands; the two states settled into a new confrontation along the Huai and the Dabie range, and for some twelve years there was no large-scale fighting. Technically the campaign showed that the Song army, with its river defences and its mountain fortresses, could hold against cavalry superiority; it also exposed the twofold limits of Song's reliance on defence and of a Mongol expedition unable to sustain itself in the south. Only when Mongke launched another great campaign did the two sides return to the field.
